jd_text:
Software Development Engineer - Backend
Company: ShopKart Technologies

About Us:
ShopKart is a leading e-commerce platform serving millions of users.

Requirements:
- Strong proficiency in Java or Python
- Experience with Spring Boot or Django framework
- Solid understanding of microservices architecture
- Expertise in SQL databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB)
- Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
- Strong foundation in data structures and algorithms
- Experience with message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ)

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Kubernetes and Docker
- Knowledge of AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines
- Understanding of event-driven architecture

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement scalable backend services
- Write clean, testable, and well-documented code
- Participate in system design discussions
- Mentor junior developers
